mapper.sql: select t.contract_id, t.contract_no, t.customer_id, t.quote_id, t.contract_amount, t.paid_amount, t.amount_diff_note, t.sign_date, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.finish_date, t.status, t.dept_id, t.owner_user_id, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, c.customer_name, c.phone as customer_phone, c.estate, c.house_type, c.area, c.budget, q.quote_no, ou.nick_name as owner_user_name from biz_contract t left join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = t.customer_id left join biz_quote q on q.quote_id = t.quote_id left join sys_user ou on ou.user_id = t.owner_user_id
mapper.insert: insert into biz_contract (contract_no, customer_id, quote_id, contract_amount, paid_amount, amount_diff_note, sign_date, start_date, end_date, status, dept_id, owner_user_id, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{contractNo}, #{customerId}, #{quoteId}, #{contractAmount}, 0, #{amountDiffNote}, #{signDate}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{deptId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update:
update biz_contract
contract_no = #{contractNo}, customer_id = #{customerId}, quote_id = #{quoteId}, contract_amount = #{contractAmount}, paid_amount = #{paidAmount}, amount_diff_note = #{amountDiffNote}, sign_date = #{signDate}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, finish_date = #{finishDate}, status = #{status}, dept_id = #{deptId},
owner_user_id = nullif(#{ownerUserId}, 0), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate()
where contract_id = #{contractId}
